construction: A lathe-turned hardwood knob with a flush pointer pin, the boutique hi-fi / pedal idiom. The grain runs along the knob's axis: the top face is end grain (growth-ring arcs around an off-axis pith, pores as dots), the tapered flank is long grain (vertical stripes, pores as dashes). Both come from one 3D wood function in the knob's object space, so they meet at the shoulder, and the grain turns with the knob. The pointer pin's material is selectable independently of the wood species (`--inlay`: brass, nickel, copper, black-lacquered metal, or bone).
